name: Proto
long_description: Designers are no longer drawers, but builders. Yet their canvas based design tools are still built for drawing, and the coding agents they’re using are built for engineers. Proto is a coding agent with all the capabilities of Claude Code, but rebuilt from scratch for designers, with features like Midjourney’s rapid idea exploration, and Figma’s first class sharing.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/CEO at Proto. Maayan built an IDE for computational artists that was published at CHI, and has worked at Apple, Google and Browserbase, and has a Bachelors in Design & CS from Carnegie Mellon University.

launches.title: Proto: The product designer’s IDE
launches.tagline: A design tool with the accuracy of Cursor & creative freedom of Figma
launches.body:
Announcing early access to Proto, the product designer’s IDE.

I've been building creative tools for a decade. In recent years, I've become frustrated with how design tools haven’t kept up with AI workflows, pushing designers to use IDEs. That’s why @[0oj4m1t](https://x.com/0oj4m1t) and I built Proto, an IDE built specifically for designers with all the features that matter to them.

Sign up for the super secret alpha at [www.prototypes.fun](http://www.prototypes.fun)
